newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: UBS hopes 97 profits 2.0 bln Sfrs or higher.
newsitem.headline: UBS hopes 97 profits 2.0 bln Sfrs or higher.

text.p: Mathis Cabiallavetta, chief executive of Union Bank of Switzerland (UBS), said that it would be a disappointment if the bank reported profits below 2.0 billion Swiss francs on 1997 results.
He also said the bank, one of Switzerland's three largest, saw a good start to the year based on the results of the first two months.
Speaking during a news conference to report UBS's 1996 results, he said, refering to 1997 profits: "I would be disappointed if it wasn't two billion or something more.
"It was a good start in the first two months," he said.
Earlier on Friday, the bank reported a loss of 348 million Swiss francs, after profit of 1.683 billion in 1995.
The loss was expected after UBS announced an extensive restructuring last year of its domestic loan portfolio, which included taking a one-time charge of three billion francs.
